The '''Mazuma system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Nuiri sector/Legends|Nuiri sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mazuma]],<ref name="Twitter" /> site of the [[Lucre Cosminational Bank]].<ref name="The Flight of the Falcon">{{StoryCite|story=The Flight of the Falcon|book=The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 157}}</ref>
